args.notes: System spec: p99 latency constraint is only an analytic bound at L1, so keep designs with latency margin for L2. Objective is min luts_plus_ffs with accuracy_bits >= 10 (max_abs_err <= 2^-10). Prefer area-lean families (iterative / small unroll) that still meet throughput_msps >= 2.
